pages.headline: This is the tree pin you tapped, and its six pieces are numbered below.
pages.intro: A luxe tree comes down to restraint and better materials: pearl and champagne against one warm wall, a tree already sitting in its basket, a knit skirt at the base. pages.title: Six Soft Layers for a Winter Bed
pages.headline: You saved this bedroom pin, and its six pieces are in order below.
pages.intro: December in a bedroom should be quiet: flannel, an olive knit throw, faux fur at the foot of the bed, one candle in the window instead of a string of lights. This edit is the warm corner of the house rather than the party. Work through the numbers as layers, bedding first, then the cushions, then the throw you actually reach for at night.

pages.title: Three Notes of a Heritage Christmas
pages.headline: The heritage pin you tapped, with its three pieces in the order shown.
pages.intro: A heritage Christmas is inherited rather than bought in one season: oxblood velvet, green plaid wool, brass candlesticks, a low lamp left on instead of an overhead light. This edit gathers the few pieces that carry that feeling without piling decoration on decoration. Use the numbers in order for the wall, the sofa and the throw over the arm.
